title: Billion Dollar Babies
lyrics_synced:
[00:29.66] Billion dollar baby!
[00:35.06] Rubber little lady,
[00:36.40] slicker than a weasel!
[00:37.75] Grimy as an alley!
[00:38.76] Loves me like no other lover!
[00:40.45] Billion dollar baby!
[00:45.84] Rotten little monster,
[00:47.19] baby, I adore you!
[00:48.54] Man or woman living
[00:49.55] couldn't love me like you, baby!
[00:51.24] We go dancing nightly in the attic
[00:55.96] while the moon is rising in the sky!
[01:02.02] If I'm too rough, tell me!
[01:04.72] I'm so scared your little head
[01:07.92] will come off in my hands!
[01:45.17] Yeah, billion dollar baby!
[01:51.74] I got you in the dimestore!
[01:53.09] No other little girl could ever hold you
[01:54.78] any tighter, any tighter than me, baby!
[01:57.30] Billion dollar baby!
[02:02.70] Reckless like a gambler,
[02:04.04] million dollar maybe!
[02:05.39] Foamin' like dog that's been
[02:06.57] infected by the rabies!
[02:08.09] We go dancing nightly in the attic
[02:12.81] while the moon is rising in the sky!
[02:18.88] If I'm too rough, tell me!
[02:21.57] I'm so scared your little head
[02:24.78] will come off in my hands!
[02:36.40] Million dollar baby!
[02:41.80] Billion dollar baby!
[02:47.19] Trillion dollar baby!
[02:52.58] Zillion dollar baby!
